messages:
maria: quick sync — compliance asked for an ad-hoc export: 'who changed routing-policy X between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-07' and they want provenance: rollout id, justification, and the console diff anchor. current ndjson export only has actor_id and timestamp. can we add lightweight hints so auditors can tie events to rollouts?
chris: +1. simplest useful fields: rollout_id, change_reason, config_snapshot_ref (s3 path or signed url). also actor_email_hint (not full PII) for easier triage.
sunil: technically we have actor_id, change_blob_id, and a rollout_tag in the change pipeline but not exposed to export. exposing rollout_tag is fine. actor_email_hint would require a join to identity service — we could include an obfuscated email hash and a small hint like email_domain to avoid exposing full emails.
jess: must be careful about PII. two export modes: full (for legal/compliance with access controls) and scrubbed (for customer ops). we should add export_metadata.mode = "redacted" | "full" and export_metadata.redaction_policy = "hash_email" etc.
arjun: proposal: add these fields to each ndjson line: rollout_id, justification_text (truncated to 512 chars), actor_hint (email_domain or username_hint), signed_snapshot (short url, expires), provenance_flags (array of strings). example payload:
```
{"event_ts":"2026-03-03T14:12:01Z","actor_id":"acct::1234","actor_hint":"@acme.com","rollout_id":"rl-2026-03-02-7f9a","justification":"pin policy to avoid cross-tenant leak","snapshot_url":"https://redwood-exports.s3/proofs/....?sig=...&exp=...","provenance_flags":["canary","automated-rollout"]}
```
chris: love that. two implementation notes: 1) keep the fields optional to avoid breaking consumers, 2) add a version header at top of ndjson file so downstream can opt-in to new fields.
maria: agree — add a file-level header object as first line with schema_version and export_mode. that helps UX in console when downloading.
sunil: ordering/size: snapshots are expensive to attach inline — use signed_snapshot_url rather than embedding full diff. snapshot storage lifecycle should be 30 days by default for ad-hoc exports; we can make retention configurable in the export request.
jess: access controls: only tenants with export_permission + audit_log_viewer role can request full exports. redacted exports are allowed for support for a shorter time window. need an ops checklist for legal requests.
arjun: UX question — console should show a preview column for provenance (rollout id + truncated reason) and a link 'download proof' that triggers the signed_snapshot_url generation. do we have bandwidth to add it to the export modal this sprint?
maria: small console change should be doable as a canary feature flag. backend: i'll scope an API shape: POST /exports/audit with body {range, mode(full|redacted), include_provenance: bool, retention_days:int} and it returns job_id + download_url when ready.
chris: and include export_schema_version in response. job should also surface missing_provenance_warnings if some events don't map to a rollout (important for manual changes).
sunil: note for implementers: when include_provenance=true, populate actor_hint by resolving actor_id->domain_hint (cacheable), and attach rollout_id if change_blob.rollout_tag exists, otherwise null. also emit telemetry metric: export.provenance.percent_populated.
ops-bot: export job 4060012501 started by maria for policy X (mode=redacted). status: queued. :gear:
maria: thanks all — i'll draft API PR and a minimal ndjson header with schema_version v1.1 and share a prototype snippet in #eng-platform-PRs. tagging @chris for api review and @jess for compliance sign-off. :white_check_mark:
